en.title: Wapp Store
en.summary: Install, search and remove apps from xprs.dev/apps
en.body: The app store for XPRS. It reads the catalog published at https://xprs.dev/apps, shows what each app does, and installs, updates or removes it with one tap. Other repositories, a URL or a Reticulum folder, can be added on its Repositories screen.

pt.title: Loja de Apps
pt.summary: Instale, procure e remova aplicacoes de xprs.dev/apps
pt.body: A loja de aplicacoes do XPRS. Le o catalogo publicado em https://xprs.dev/apps, mostra o que cada aplicacao faz e instala, atualiza ou remove com um toque. Outros repositorios, um URL ou uma pasta Reticulum, podem ser adicionados no ecra Repositorios.

de.title: App Store
de.summary: Apps von xprs.dev/apps installieren, suchen und entfernen
de.body: Der App Store fuer XPRS. Er liest den auf https://xprs.dev/apps veroeffentlichten Katalog, zeigt, was jede App tut, und installiert, aktualisiert oder entfernt sie mit einem Tipp. Weitere Repositories, eine URL oder ein Reticulum-Ordner, lassen sich im Bildschirm Repositories hinzufuegen.

changelog:
## 1.4.0
- Reads the catalog at https://xprs.dev/apps (catalog.json) by default
- The host fetches and caches the catalog and checks each package's sha256
- Search, and remove from a card

## 1.0.0
- Multi-source repository support
- Install and update wapps
- Publisher verification via NOSTR signatures
